name: Tilaknagar Industries Ltd
title: Tilaknagar Industries Ltd-$ - 507205 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Volumes up 135% in Q4 on Imperial Blue acquisition, but growth is acquisition-driven; ex-IB Q4 volume flat and utilisation/capacity signals are thin, with FY27 guidance of HSD-LDD volume growth and 16-18% EBITDA margin over 24-36 months.

capex.quote: capex, I think, will be maintenance capex for both the years. I do not think capex will be large. Approximately, we can take INR 25 crore in each of the years.

triggers.label: EBITDA margin 16-18% over 24-36 months
triggers.quote: we expect the consolidated EBITDA margins to reach 16%-18% for the combined business over the next 24 to 36 months.

triggers.label: Prag capacity 6 to 36 lakh cases
triggers.quote: The capacity has now increased from 6 lakh cases per annum to 36 lakh cases per annum.

triggers.label: Q4 volume +135% YoY to 8m+ cases
triggers.quote: our overall volumes increased by 135% on a year-on-year basis, crossing 8 million cases, of which IB was 4.6 million cases.

triggers.label: Q1 input cost inflation flagged
triggers.quote: we have faced certain input cost inflations in Q1. So in Q1, I mean it will be incorrect of me to say that we will expand on these margins.

triggers.label: Telangana dues still elevated
triggers.quote: we are actively working with the government authorities to try and reduce the number of days of outstanding.

guidance.quote: For FY27, we expect to achieve a high-single digit to low-double digit volume growth for the combined business
we expect the consolidated EBITDA margins to reach 16%-18% for the combined business over the next 24 to 36 months.
we expect the net debt-to-EBITDA ratio to go below 1.0x by FY29.
By the end of March-27, you are looking at a net debt of approximately INR 1,700 crore or thereabouts.
full year impact of, let us call it, anywhere between INR 55 crore to INR 60 crore.
we can look at the working capital cycle in the range of 53 to 55 days of gross revenue.
Approximately, we can take INR 25 crore in each of the years.
We expect a double digit volume CAGR over the next 3 years.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Exit TSMA for significant operations by end Q4 FY26
prior_guidance_check.quote: In the Q3 earnings call, we had mentioned that TI will exit the TSMA for significant operations by the end of Q4 FY26, and we have delivered on that.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Net debt to EBITDA below 1.0x by FY29
prior_guidance_check.quote: As guided in the past as well, we expect the net debt-to-EBITDA ratio to go below 1.0x by FY29.

red_flags.label: Telangana receivable days elevated
red_flags.quote: we are actively working with the government authorities to try and reduce the number of days of outstanding.

red_flags.label: Reported revenue basis changed to net of selling costs
red_flags.quote: This change will have a negative impact on reported revenue and gross margins, but will have a positive impact on EBITDA margins and PAT margins.

evasions.quote: we are not giving a NSR segregation on a brand-wise basis.
we are not explicitly sharing that number.
obviously, timelines are not known on that front.
